entries.clue: Every cunning plan is his; the turnip-loving dogsbody of Blackadder
Rainy capital of red buses where the Browns keep house at number thirty-two
Green car Mr Bean once drove from an armchair lashed to its roof
Outfit judged on how unrecognisable it makes the wearer
Red-suited carrier of a pitchfork, tail ending in an arrow point
Manic Torquay hotelier, seen thrashing his stalled car with a leafy branch
Two slices with marmalade between, kept beneath a hat for emergencies
Hooded blue duffle, bought for a new arrival on a family shopping trip
Small knobbly growth, stuck on a false nose to finish a hideous face
Tea left standing to strengthen, or a dark mixture set simmering
Dead crewman projected back aboard as a hologram, an H on his forehead
Tub the bear rode down the stairs, on screen, in a flood of his own making
